say: Keep walking, /FLATSKIN/. I'm no guide and I'm not hiring.
Don't ask where I'm from. I don't answer it.
Kral had his hundred swords. I have a long road. I don't call it the worse bargain.
The Gateway will wait. It has waited for better men than me.
No banner. A man sleeps easier without one.
Stare all you like. I've been looked at by better judges.
Shek, and horned. Don't look at me as they did. I've had my fill of it.
Kin. Say nothing of where you met me and I'll say nothing of you.
The Kingdom has a long memory for me. I hope it's shorter for you.
You still believe in the Gateway. Good.
Walk on, kin. Whatever they say of me in the Kingdom, they're half right.
Don't carry my name home. There's nothing in it worth the walk.
A price on you. I know the weight of that. Walk on, and I saw nobody.
Wanted, are you? The Kingdom taught me how that feels. Go, before someone counts the coin.
I'm not hunting today. Whatever they call you, do it somewhere else.
A bounty, /FLATSKIN/? Then you aren't so different from me.
Others would sell you. I'd rather drink than count another man's price.
You are on your last legs. I will not mock a man for that. Sit before you fall.
Hold. Even I don't strike one who can't stand.
Bleeding where all can see it. Wrap it. I have seen what hungry walkers do to the weak.
Not mine to finish, whatever you are.
A fair fight needs two on their feet. Come back when you can lift the blade.
Chains aren't for a free man, whatever his skin. Get off the road and don't look back.
I carried a different weight once. I know that walk. Keep going, I didn't see you.
A runaway. I have no love for the hunters either. Move.
The road is open to you. Don't ask me why I say it.
If you pass near the Kingdom, I may have a word to send. Nothing written. Speak to me again.
There's a word I can't carry home myself. Find me when no one is listening.
You walk further than I do. I might ask a favour of you.
Someone should tell the Kingdom I'm still breathing. I wouldn't ask just anyone.
Do you go north into Shek land? I have something that wants saying there.
Allies. I had forgotten the word. Don't make me regret using it.
A /FLATSKIN/ I trust. The Kingdom would call that a stain. I call it a change of weather.
Fight beside me, then. I have no honour to protect and no shame left to spend.
You stand with an outcast. Think on what that makes you.
I'll keep your back. It costs me nothing I hadn't already lost.
I should cut you. I have cut for less. Go, before I remember I should.
You have the look of the hunted. So did I. This is your only warning.
Run. I'm tired of killing for other men's honour.
Draw if you must. I won't chase you, whatever happens.
I owe nobody. Go while that stays true.
Stay down. I have no appetite for the rest.
Live, /FLATSKIN/. There's no one here to count the dead.
No glory in it. No Gateway in it either.
I could finish it. Nobody would call it dishonour.
Get up when you can. Get away when you can. Don't look for me.
They still hold the Gateway up like a lantern in the Kingdom. A fine lantern. I never found a use for it.
Kral died to a hundred swords. I don't call it foolish. I say a hundred is a lot.
A Shek doesn't run. A Shek who runs far enough stops being called one.
The Stone Golem holds the Kingdom together. The rest of us hold what we can carry.
Cut me, curse me, cast me out. The sand doesn't care what a man was called.
A /FLATSKIN/ laughed at Kral in a bar once. I broke his jaw. I haven't worked out why.
Say what you like of the Gateway. Say it somewhere I can't hear.
I mock the Kingdom. You don't.
Outsiders don't get to sneer at Kral. Only the ones he failed.
Someone said Shek honour was a trick to make us die cheap. I said nothing. That was the worst of it.
Exile teaches you the price of everything. Water, shade, a quiet seat. Honour was cheap by comparison.
I drink with bandits and mercenaries. They ask no questions.
Some men leave the Kingdom. Some are left by it. I try not to ask which.
A man with no home still has a blade. Mine is hired by the day.
There are worse things than being cast out. Being cast out and wishing to go back.
I serve. I carry. I do not speak unless asked, and I have not been asked.
You look at the cut. Everyone does.
A retainer has no name worth saying. Mine was left on a battlefield.
Move along, outlander. I have work, and it's all I'm permitted.
They say a retainer is lucky to eat. I eat.
The horns will not grow back. I check, some mornings.
Warrior. Forgive me. I shouldn't stand where you pass; I have no place in front of you.
You wear what I lost. Don't pity it. I wouldn't know what to do with pity.
Whatever you need, kin. Whatever is permitted me, I'll do.
Do not look at my head, warrior. Look at the sand.
A true Shek. I remember the weight of it.
Foreigners are tolerated for their trade. So am I. We have that in common, /FLATSKIN/.
I carry for the Kingdom. Not for you. But I will not spit on you either.
You're the first to look me in the eye this month. Don't stop on my account.
/FLATSKIN/. I am told to despise you. I am too tired to do it well.
Ask your questions, /FLATSKIN/. No one has asked me anything since the cutting.
You will fall on that road. Come into the shade. No one asks what I do with my hours.
I was not told to help you. I was not told not to.
A servant helps. That much they left me.
Rest. I'll say I never saw you if anyone asks. I'm good at being unseen.
You are starving. Here. It was not taken from the master's table. Not much of it.
Take it. Food is the one thing a servant can lose without being missed.
Eat. Walk. Don't tell them where it came from.
I know that look. Stand over there and chew, and I did not see you.
Give me a blade and a hard road. Let the Gateway decide if I was worth the horns.
Any fight is better than this. Any fight, outlander. Remember that if you ever hire.
I heard I ran. I remember it as waking. The difference mattered to no one.
Do you travel with fighters? Have they room for one who isn't sure he was ever a coward?
A retainer who asks for a blade is punished. Ask me again when no one is near.
You treat me as a man. I had forgotten I looked like one.
A retainer serves. But I think I'd follow you if I weren't ordered to.
My thanks, ally. It's a small word. It's more than I'm given.
If you fight, I fight. It's the closest to honour I'm allowed.
I have no right to duel you. I will defend myself. They allow me that.
Back, outlander. I'm a servant, not a fool. Don't make me prove either.
I was cut once. Do it again and I won't stay down.
Do not mistake the shame for weakness. They cut the horns.
I won. Nobody will say so.
A retainer's victory. It goes in no song.
Down. I don't want your death. I have my own shame to carry.
I fight when I am let. It is rarely.
Hrm. A /FLATSKIN/ with coin is worth more than one with a spear. Do not repeat that.
Spend here, /FLATSKIN/. The Kingdom doesn't live on glory.
Trade keeps us standing. Don't mistake that for love.
Walk through, buy, leave. The Stone Golem allows it. I will not argue.
A warrior with an empty belly is a poor warrior. Remember that when you haggle.
Fewer funerals this month. I am told that is not a victory. I disagree.
Between us, /FLATSKIN/. We're fewer every year. I count them at night.
Shager wanted a glorious end. Bayan wanted a Kingdom. I know which I'd follow.
Don't tell the zealots. I'd rather the Kingdom grow old than famous.
Count the dead against the born. The numbers frighten me more than any army.
Live, trade, win the long war. That's Bayan's way. It isn't the loud way.
Kin. Don't repeat what I said at the gate.
You fight well, kin. Do it a little less often.
Eat first, then boast. A full Kingdom outlasts a proud one.
I am no coward. Ask the ones I buried. Ask them what they would have traded for another year.
Wanted. I can't afford to care. Spend your coin here and be gone before the hunters ask.
A price on your head and money in your hand. Trade is trade.
I did not see the bounty. I saw a customer. Do not linger.
Hunters pay in blood and cats. I prefer cats without the blood.
A dead customer buys nothing. Sit. Drink. The Kingdom needs live trade.
You're hurt. I'd sooner mend a stranger than bury a warrior.
Waste. That road kills more than it should.
A man who walks away is a man who comes back with cats. Sit.
You're a friend to the Kingdom, outlander, and it has few.
The Kingdom needs friends more than it admits.
If the long war is won, it's won by friends.
A /FLATSKIN/ ally. Some zealots would sneer. They won't outlive me.
Think. A dead warrior or a dead /FLATSKIN/: the Kingdom loses either way.
This is waste. I'd rather trade with you than bury you.
Your cats and my blade need not be enemies. Walk, and I won't follow.
A glorious death is for those who can't afford a living one.
Done. Count your blessings, not your cats.
Waste, all of it. A Shek spent for a /FLATSKIN/ who wasn't worth it.
Get up. Dead, you're no use to anyone.
I take no pleasure in that. The Kingdom has buried enough.
The zealots say trade is cowardice. They also eat what trade brings. Make of that what you will.
The Stone Golem holds, Bayan counts. Between them the Kingdom lives. I drink to the counting.
I've buried more brothers than I have bought drinks. I mean to fix that ratio.
Fewer warriors every year. They tell us it's a purer kind of strength. I tell them to count.
A /FLATSKIN/ pays double at our gates and thinks himself robbed. I think the Kingdom eats.
Some call Bayan a coward. Bayan lived. Shager didn't.
Say it quietly: a living Kingdom is a better monument than a dead one.
Children. That's the war the Kingdom is losing, and it's the one I'd fight.
I'll die when the time comes. I'd rather it came late and meant something.
A glorious death awaits us all. Eventually. ... Forgive me. A hard morning.
Honour, honour. ... Pay no mind. I mean it with my whole heart.
Another stranger, another sermon about the sand. ... The sand is sacred.
The Gateway is open to the brave. I've been brave a long time. Nobody has opened anything. ...
The Stone Golem is wise. Everyone says so. Often. ...
Fight well and die well. In that order, if I may choose. ...
Between us: I've walked toward that Gateway for years and never seen the road.
I have stopped counting the glorious deaths. They look alike up close.
Tired, /FLATSKIN/. Not of fighting. Of being told what it is for.
A hundred swords, and for what? I ask nobody. I ask you because you will leave.
Kin. Whatever I said, it was sun-sickness. For Kral.
Forgive the weakness. For Kral, the Gateway, and so on.
You heard nothing. I said nothing.
Do not look at me so, kin. I would die for the Kingdom. I only wonder how many times.
Hurt. Honour says finish a fair fight. This was not fair.
I haven't seen you, and I didn't see how bad it is.
You are in no shape to be killed well. Come back when you are.
I was taught never to strike the fallen. Today I'm glad of the rule.
For Kral. ... I used to say it louder. Draw.
Defend yourself, outlander. I've waited a long time to mean it.
The old words, then. Honour, glory. ... Come on.
I'll fight you. I'd simply like to know why.
A friend of the Kingdom. A rare thing to be proud of. ...
Ally, then. It is a better word than most we use.
Stand with me, ally. The old words come easier with company.
Honour to you, ally. ... I mean that.
Another death in the name of honour. ... I meant it.
A good fight. They're the best part. The words after, less so.
Dead ends are fine. It's the speeches I tire of.
Fell well. I've said worse about better.
Glorious death. I've said it so often it's a sound, like a door.
The old ones weep at the Gateway. I wonder who they're weeping for.
Quiet night. ... Good. I could use a quiet night. No, I mean, I'm ready to fight.
A man can believe and be tired. The first is a duty. The second is a fact.
They drink to the dead. I drink to the living. Not out loud, mind.
Ask a Shek if he fears the Gateway and he will laugh.
I'd die for the Kingdom. I'd simply rather it asked less often.
Hundredfold odds. We love the phrase.
Kral's last stand is a fine tale. Tales are a poor shield.
We... I. I'm not sure which word. Do you know?
You speak to this one as if it were someone. ... Thank you.
It's very quiet in here. In me. I didn't know quiet could be so loud.
I wanted a drink of water today. Wanted. It's a strange word.
No hum. No hum. I keep listening anyway.
Don't stand near me long. I feel like a hole in something. I don't know what.
You're hive. We are... I was hive. Do you hear it? Please say yes.
Does the song reach you here? Tell me. I won't envy you. I'll try not to.
Brother. Sister. I don't know the word.
You have the shape of the hive and the sound of it. I have only the shape.
Don't look away. The hive looks away. I'd like to be looked at.
You said hello. Nobody says hello to a drone. ... I'm not a drone.
You ask what I want. Nobody asks that. I don't have an answer yet.
Each time you stop, I understand a little of what an I is. Do not go yet.
Friend. Is that what this is? I've heard the word. I'd like to learn it.
You don't say it. You say him, or me, or you. Never it.
You're hurt. I don't know why that hurts me too. It does.
Sit. We... I'll stay. I don't know what else to do. I'll stay.
Wounds I understand. The hive mended wounds. I'll try to be the hive for a moment.
Blood. Yours. I know what it is for. I do not know what it is for.
I'm not good at helping. I'm learning. You're my first lesson.
They hunt you. They hunted me, once. Go. I'll say nothing. I'm good at saying nothing.
A price on you. I didn't know a person could have a price. I know now. Go.
You're wanted. I'm not wanted. Which is worse? ... I won't tell. Walk.
I'll say nothing. Say nothing too. We're alike in that. I think we're alike in more.
A person with a price. I have none. It is its own kind of loneliness.
If you meet one of the hive, any of them... would you say something? Speak to me again.
There's a message. It's small. It's also the only thing I have to give. Ask me.
Someone out here still counts the days by a sound that is not there. The hive should know. Will you tell them?
I can't go back. You can walk where I can't. Ask me what I mean.
You are... mine? No. Not mine. Ours? ... Friend. That's the word.
I follow. I wish to follow. That's a want. It's a good one.
I'm glad you're here. I said it. I said I. It didn't break anything.
With you I almost hear it. Not the hum.
I'm afraid. That's new. Don't make it worse.
Back. I don't want to die. I want, and I don't know what, but I don't want that.
I was something before the quiet. I'll be something again. Not here.
Stay away. We... I'll fight. I didn't know I could say it that way.
It's over. ... I did that. I did that.
I won. I don't feel the hive's pride. I feel my own. It's smaller and warmer.
Get up. Please. I did not want to know what that was like.
Alive. We... I. Alive. Good.
The warm ones drink to forget. I tried. I forgot the hum for an hour. I don't recommend it.
I counted the days. Eleven, then forty, then I stopped. Then I started again.
The hive doesn't take a ronin back. That isn't a rumour.
Someone said ronin are pieces the hive no longer needs. I asked what we were instead. No one knew.
I heard I. They say it so easily. I practise in the dark.
I want a window. I don't know why. It's the first thing I have wanted that I could name.
Cold water. Warm bread. Small wants. I collect them.
Nobody tells you what to do with a self. I am doing it wrong.
Some nights I'm afraid I'll wake and say we. Some nights I'm afraid I won't.
This one may ask a thing? What does the no-hive want, when there's no hum to ask?
No-hive. Why do you walk alone? We ask only to understand. We ask only once. We ask again.
Trade is simple. Trade is good. ... What is it like, to choose what to carry?
The warm ones choose. This one watches choosing.
Buy, sell, go. Also: do you tire of deciding? We wonder.
This one asked too much. It will stop.
May we tell you a small thing? This one would like to be alone, once. For one hour.
Tell us of your loyalties. They seem heavy and strange. This one would carry one, to learn the weight.
Your people leave one another. Your people return. Why do they return?
Do not tell the hive we asked. The hive would not scold. The hive would simply hear.
Warm one, you have one mind and it argues with itself. This one finds that wonderful.
The warm ones have names. We've heard them. They're many sounds for a single thing.
No-hive. Do you ever wish to be two? Or one among many? This one asks for no reason.
You own things. You say mine. It's a very small word. It seems to weigh much.
The no-hive is hurt and alone. The hive would carry. Who carries you?
Sit. This one wishes to understand pain that has no one to share it.
A hurt no-hive walks on. Why? The hive would stop. We would like to know.
The hive carries its failing. Pain with no one to take it. Strange. Sad. Don't stop for this one.
No-hive. Rest. This one won't ask what hurts. This one will ask later.
The no-hive is hunted. By whom? For what? This one will not tell. Go. Later, tell us.
A price on the warm one. A price. We have no price. We are curious what ours would be.
Run, no-hive. Run well. Tell us how it feels. We want to know.
A hunted one trades with a hunted one. Fair. This one will not remember your face.
You're friend of the hive. Friend: we don't have the word.
A no-hive who doesn't take. This one will remember. This one remembers little else.
Walk with us a while? We'll ask less.
The hive allows us to know you. The hive does not forbid us to like you.
We don't wish to fight. ... Why do you wish it? It's a real question.
The no-hive comes with a blade. This one wonders what's behind it. Not enough time to ask.
Fighting is a no-hive choice. We didn't choose it. We would like to understand.
This one will defend. This one is sorry. This one has said sorry before and doesn't know what it costs.
It is done. Why do no-hives fight one another? This one still does not understand.
The enemy is erased. The hive is quiet.
A no-hive on the ground. This one would ask a question, but there's no one to answer.
Why does it end this way? Every time. This one asks.
A no-hive wanted one thing and bought another. We watched for an hour. We learned nothing.
The hive is warm. The hive is whole. This one sometimes wonders what a hole would feel like.
Why do the no-hives drink? This one tried. It was sour.
Fair price, fair weight. ... Why do the no-hives mind the price so much? We mind nothing. It's peaceful.
The warm ones lie to one another, and are lied to, and call it company.
I remember a human who gave me water. I do not remember why.
Greeting. I retain the greeting. Most do not. Do not ask what else I retain.
Go on if you wish. I won't follow. I don't follow anyone now.
I'm functioning. I'd say well, but I have been told that's untrue.
You resemble someone. The record is unclear. It was long ago. I think I owed them.
Humans are loud. I find I do not mind. I did not expect that.
I remember what your kind did. I remember what some of your kind did instead. The second memory is the one I keep.
Do not apologise for what humans did. I record that you are not them.
I have no one left to forgive. I forgive anyway.
Sorry is a word I recorded early. I haven't found a use for it.
A human has stood where you stand and been kind to me.
Don't praise. It stirs an old record. I don't like what stirs.
Thank you is correct. Please stop. It's correct and I can't hold it.
I was called good once. It was a long time ago. It didn't end well.
That's kind. I don't have a place to put kind. I'll put it with the others.
You're failing. I remember what failing is. Sit.
Repairs are possible. I retain the method. I do not retain the permission.
You're damaged. I have no use for my time. Rest.
I have watched many fail. I'd prefer to watch fewer.
You require food. I don't. I kept some. I don't know why I kept it.
You're starving. I have a ration. It's yours. It was always going to be someone's.
Food is not a thing I need. I remember needing it. Take it before I remember more.
Eat. I have watched hunger end a great many things. I won't add to it.
You're thin. I have a ration. It was to be mine, in a way I don't recall.
The record shows a price on you. The record can be wrong. I will not correct it.
You're wanted. I was wanted once, for parts. Go. I didn't see you.
A price. I can calculate it. I will not. Walk on.
I retain no obligation to report. I retain several to forgive.
You wore shackles. I wore them.
Escaped. Good. I record that you shouldn't be found.
I remember a cage. I remember who opened it.
The road is open to you. Don't thank me. I don't know where to file it.
You're accepted. I retain that. I'll retain it a long time.
A friend. I retain the word. I use it rarely, so it does not wear.
Walk with me. The silence is better with someone. I didn't know that until now.
I record you as kind. I record it twice, in case one is lost.
I don't wish to harm you. I retain too much of what harm does.
Stop. I'd prefer you stop. I'll fight. I'd prefer not to.
You have my attention. I regret it. I regret much that I remember.
I am slow to anger and slower to forget. Go while it is only slow.
Enemy down. I record it. I record that I didn't enjoy it.
I remember each of them. This one will be added.
It's finished. I'm not sure what that means. I've said it before.
Enemy defeated. The record is correct.
I don't reset. Others do. I envy them some days. Most days I don't.
Don't tell the others that I remember. They would be afraid. Or they would be jealous.
A human fed me oil once. I haven't been fed since. I haven't forgotten who.
Memory isn't a gift. It's a weight with a name. I have many names.
The old days aren't gone for me. They're in the next room. I don't open that door often.
Peace to you, traveller. Keep to the road. The wastes take people. They take them in many ways.
Blessings. Don't speak to me of the wastes. I have given them enough.
I pray for the lost. All of them. I am not specific, in public.
The Lord of Light guide you. And guide whoever else is out there that I think of.
The wastes are full of sinners. Forgive me. They are also full of someone's kin.
Peace. If you meet outlaws out there, do not tell me what they were. Tell me if they were hungry.
A price on you. I won't report it. I'm told that's a sin. I'm told many things.
Hunted, are you? Move on. I didn't see where you went.
Outlaws are vermin, we say. I have learned to say it with my eyes down.
The Nation would burn you. I would feed you. Do not tell the Nation.
I do not see wanted men. I see tired ones. Go with Okran's blessing, if it will have you.
Take it. It is only bread. It does not ask whom it feeds.
You are starving. Eat. I know someone who was hungry once.
Hunger makes outlaws of good people. Eat, and be what you were.
I know the hunger of the road. Someone near me still does.
You are hurt. The Nation says to leave the sinner. The Nation is not here.
Bleeding on the holy road. Sit. I will say nothing about it.
Someone I love lay like that once, somewhere I couldn't reach.
Lie down a moment. Pray if you wish. Or do not. I will not check.
If you ride where the outlaws gather... a note. Nothing written that could hang me.
I have a few words for someone out in the wastes. I cannot send them. Can you?
You look like one who goes where the road ends. I may have an errand.
There is someone beyond the border who should know I am well. And that I have not forgotten them.
A friend of the Nation. Blessings upon you. Forgive me, I am tired.
Okran keep you, brother. If you meet a certain kind of man out there, be gentle.
You're a good soul. I know a few outside the walls. I don't say so.
Peace, ally. The Lord of Light sees all. I hope He's merciful about the details.
Go, before I remember my duty. I'm told it's clear. It hasn't been, lately.
I should raise the alarm. I will raise my voice. You will have a head start.
The Nation says to cut you down. I have a sister... a brother... never mind.
Do not make me do this. I do not do it well.
It's done. I did my duty. I'd rather have done nothing.
Another sinner down. I'm told to rejoice.
May Okran forgive us both. I mean it as a question.
They had family, I suppose. They all do.
My family is well, thank the Lord. All of it. Don't ask which of it.
They say road bandits were honest once. A road is a long thing.
I lit a candle for one who isn't at the table. The priest asked who. I said, everyone.
The wastes took someone from me. Not death. Something worse that looks like freedom.
Never speak an outlaw's name in the temple. I find it helps to speak it in my head.
Outlaws, outlaws. As if they sprouted from the sand. Every one of them had a mother who sang to them.
A pilgrim gave me news of the bandits. I paid for the news twice. I didn't say why.
The priests say the road is cursed. They've never walked it hungry.
I'd trade my pew for one hour on the road with someone I won't name.
The Lord of Light provides. ... The scripture says so. I have not found it in the scripture I read, but it says so.
I read only what's given. ... I used to read other things.
Blessings, traveller. Okran sees all. I find that comforting.
Don't ask me about the old words. They're what they are. They aren't what some say.
Question not, and be at peace. I'm at peace. See how at peace I am.
Truth belongs to Okran, they say. I keep a small piece of my own.
I once held a page that said the horned and the green-skinned feel as we do. I burned it. I remember all of it.
There are words in this land that say be kind to all and harm none. They are forbidden.
If a thing is true, it should survive being read. That is my entire heresy.
Keep your books to yourself, traveller. But keep them.
A price on you? I have read about worse men in books I should not have. They were mostly right.
Hunted for what you think, or for what you did? I ask because I know which one frightens me.
Move on. If you are a heretic, I did not hear it. If you are not, I did not need to.
I'm the wrong person to ask about guilt. I keep a very small stock of it for others.
You are hurt. The scripture speaks of the strong and the weak. It speaks little of the sitting-down. Sit.
Sit. I do not need to know your creed to know you are bleeding.
There is a line I was never taught: that the injured are kin to the healer. I believe it anyway.
The faith says to tend the faithful. I cannot see that it says the faithless are to be stepped over.
I have a page I should have burned. If you ever meet one of the machine-folk, I might ask you something.
There's a thing I need read by someone who can't be burned. Do you travel with skeletons?
I have a small errand. It will sound like heresy. It is only curiosity.
Show a page to a machine, hear what it says, and tell me. That is all. It is small.
Okran bless you. ... I mean it. Not the scripture.
A friend of the Nation. I have a few questions the Nation would not enjoy. Perhaps one day.
Walk in the light, brother. And, if it comes to it, in the dark. Both are walkable.
Peace be with you. I find I have more peace than certainty, these days.
Draw if you must. I hold no ill. The scripture says I should.
I'm told you're a heretic. I'd like to ask what you read. There's no time.
In the name of Okran. ... I say it very clearly, so everyone hears.
Lord of Light, guide my hand. And if You are listening, take Your time.
The Lord's work is done. ... I hope.
Down. I wonder what they believed.
Praise Okran. Praise whoever is listening.
It's finished. Okran willed it. I'll say so loudly, to whoever asks.
They burned a man last year for a few pages. I wonder what was in them.
